headline: Nvidia reportedly in early talks to acquire open-weight model maker Reflection AI
body: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to acquire Reflection AI, a U.S. maker of open-weight models, according to a report by the Financial Times. Sources told the FT that the discussions are in an early phase, and that Nvidia has already invested $800 million in the company.
note: For banks weighing models they can run themselves, the report points to Nvidia pushing open-weight models that users can run on their own hardware. According to the sources, the deal could also end as a deeper investment.

evidence.text: Nvidia is reportedly in talks to acquire Reflection AI , a U.S. maker of open-weight artificial intelligence models.
That’s according to a report Saturday (Oct. 10) by the Financial Times (FT)
Sources with knowledge of the matter told FT that the discussions are in an early phase, and that the deal could play out in various ways.
Nvidia could also decide to deepen its investment in Reflection, the sources said.
Nvidia has already invested $800 million into the company, the report added.
Nvidia has in recent months been focusing more and more on encouraging a market for open-weight AI models, which users can customize and run on their own hardware.
